Overview

Craiova is a city in Dolj with a population of 269,506. A major economic center in Oltenia, known for its beautiful botanical garden, historic old town, and a growing automotive and aerospace industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
